title: files:assembly exists even when assembly support is off
claim: Verdict: broken. Both command line pages say the task is only available when assembly support is enabled. The `files` namespace creates a task for each of tests, source, assembly, headers and support unconditionally. With `:test_build` ↳ `:use_assembly: FALSE` and no release assembly, `ceedling files:assembly` runs and prints `Assembly files: None`.

title: The Dependencies doc names a files:include task that does not exist
claim: Verdict: broken. The doc lists `files:include` as "Lists every header file Ceedling has found, including those from dependencies". The core defines `files:header` for that. `ceedling files:include` ends with `Unrecognized build task`. `paths:include` is real.

title: Dependency include directories and globs are added to the header file collection as literal entries
claim: Verdict: defect. `include_files` maps every `:includes` entry, whether a header, a directory or a glob, to a path below the artifact path. `Dependencies#config` and `#add_headers_and_sources` push all of them into `collection_all_headers`. With `:includes: [inc/**, single/one.h]`, `files:header` lists `dependencies/Vend/inc/**` as a header file.

title: A dependency's :artifact path skips :source and :fetch when :build is left out
claim: Verdict: broken. The docs say `:artifact` falls back to `:build`, and `:build` falls back to `:source`, then `:fetch`. The code reads `@paths[:artifact] || @paths[:build] || default_path`. A dependency with only `:source: ext/src` gets build `ext/src` but artifact `dependencies/<name>`. In the build, `:includes: [inc/**]` of such a dependency appears in `paths:include` as `dependencies/Vend/inc`, not `vendor_dep/inc`. A fix changes where artifacts are looked for, so it is a BreakingChanges candidate.

title: dependencies:clean misses a default path that a fetch used
claim: Verdict: partly kept. The doc says clean removes "every one of its working paths". `working_paths` returns the configured paths only (`@paths` less `:deploy`), and the default `dependencies/<name>` is used only when a path falls back to it. With only `:artifact: out` configured, fetch and source resolve to `dependencies/<name>` while clean removes only `out`. With only `:build: b`, clean removes only `b`. Fetch then sees a non-empty fetch path and skips.

title: Dependency artifacts resolve against the artifact path, absolute names stand, and ~ expands
claim: Verdict: kept. `artifact_at` standardizes the entry, which expands a leading `~`, then keeps an absolute path as written and joins any other below `artifact_path`.

title: dependencies:deploy copies dynamic libraries and executables beside the release executable by default
claim: Verdict: kept. The destination is `spec.deploy_path(File.dirname(PROJECT_RELEASE_BUILD_TARGET))`. The target lies below `<build root>/release/` (for example `build/release/project.out`), not in the artifacts directory.

title: Dependency fetch runs in the fetch path and build steps run in the source path
claim: Verdict: kept. Fetch steps run inside `spec.fetch_path` after it is created, so a relative archive `:source` is relative to the fetch path. Each build step runs in `spec.source_path`, and the source, build and artifact paths are created first. Both use `WorkingDir.chdir`.

title: Dependency :source artifacts join the include and source collections, not :paths :source
claim: Verdict: kept. `add_source_path` appends each `:source` directory to four include-style collections and its C files to `collection_all_source`. It does not touch `collection_paths_source`. The doc promises search paths and release sources only.

title: A :build_lib static library is built in :build and copied to :artifact when they differ
claim: Verdict: kept. The first `:static_libraries` entry is built at `<build path>/<entry>` and copied to `<artifact path>/<entry>` unless the two paths are equal. Object placement is GAP-04's.
